alice_support: Heads up — customer (Globex) reporting SSE stream that silently stalls mid-response. No HTTP close, socket remains ESTABLISHED, client never gets the final [DONE].

frank_customer_rep: Environment: customer on-prem ingress -> corporate BlueShield proxy -> our Private VPC. They mentioned VPC uses jumbo frames (MTU 9000) but corporate gear clamps MSS to 1400. They attached tcpdump + app logs.

erin_customer_success: Repro they gave (curl):

```
curl -N -H \"Accept: text/event-stream\" -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \\
  \"https://private.globex.example/v1/streams/generate?model=redwood-8b\" \\
  -d '{\"prompt\":\"long prompt...\",\"max_tokens\":7000}'
```

They see data events for a while, then nothing new for >1m, no error, no [DONE].

alice_support: Pasted tcpdump excerpt from customer: lots of 1460-sized segments client->proxy, then smaller ~1360 segments proxy->vpc, then repeated DUP ACK bursts and client app stops receiving further application-layer events.

bob_oncall: @carol_eng_runtime can you triage? This smells like mid-path MSS/fragmentation + proxy buffering/idle timeouts. Could also be TCP offload or proxy inspecting/rewriting causing windows to close at application layer.

carol_eng_runtime: Two quick leads: 1) corporate proxy buffers chunked responses and has a read timeout ~60s; when buffer fills or idle timer triggers it may stop forwarding further chunks while keeping the TCP session open. 2) NIC offload + MSS mismatch can cause server to send large frames that get split/reassembled incorrectly by a middlebox, leading to duplicate ACKs and apparent blackholing.

carol_eng_runtime: Quick asks for customer: can they try forcing smaller flushes from our side (we can enable 1KB SSE flushes and add a comment keepalive every 15s) and also run `curl --no-buffer`? That will help narrow proxy buffering vs. MTU reassembly.

dan_eng_infra: We should also request proxy config: `proxy_buffer_size`, `proxy_read_timeout`, any MSS clamping, and whether TCP segmentation offload (TSO/GSO) is enabled on the ingress boxes. Many corporate proxies default to a 60s read timeout and small buffer.

frank_customer_rep: Globex responded: BlueShield proxy defaults: `proxy_read_timeout`=60s, `proxy_buffer`=16k, MSS clamp=1400. They can test toggling `proxy_buffering off` and increasing read timeout to 300s in a staging window.

alice_support: Customer ran `curl --no-buffer` and `socat` tests. With `--no-buffer` they got slightly longer streams but still saw stalls ~80-100s. With our suggested server-side 1KB flush + 15s SSE comment keepalive, they got consistent full streams across 10 runs.

carol_eng_runtime: That result strongly implicates proxy buffering + idle timer interaction. Keepalive comments prevent the proxy from hitting idle logic and smaller frames avoid triggering proxy buffer thresholds.

carol_eng_runtime: Action plan: 1) I'll stand up a temporary test endpoint in the Private control plane for Globex that allows parametric chunk_size and heartbeat interval (ETA ~2h). 2) I'll open a runtime ticket to add a fallback: when we detect DUP ACK patterns or proxies in path (via headers / heuristics), automatically switch to conservative flush sizes + periodic SSE comments.

dan_eng_infra: I'll draft a Private deployment KB and recommended proxy settings: disable proxy_buffering for SSE endpoints, set `proxy_read_timeout` >= 300s for long streams, avoid aggressive MSS clamping when VPC uses jumbo frames, and ensure TSO/GSO settings on ingress are compatible (or disable if buggy).

erin_customer_success: Globex will try changing proxy_buffering and read_timeout next week in a maintenance window and report back. They appreciate the test endpoint.

alice_support: For tracking: severity P2 for now. Keeping ticket open; will escalate if customer cannot change proxy. Also added logs + tcpdump to the ticket.

frank_customer_rep: If customer cannot change BlueShield, they asked if we can provide a host-level mitigation (app-level smaller chunk fallback).

carol_eng_runtime: Yes, we'll prototype an automatic fallback in runtime and a per-deployment toggle for Private customers. Opening runtime issue now.

support-bot: Incident created INC-2026-1173: private-sse-proxy-buffering-mss. Assigned carol_eng_runtime, dan_eng_infra.
